hook: THEY ALL TOUCHED|THE ELEPHANT|WHO WAS WRONG?

voices.name: l00
voices.text: A group who couldn't see <#0.2#> touched an elephant for the first time.
voices.caption: A group who couldn't see touched an elephant for the first time.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: The one who touched its leg <#0.2#> said it was like a pillar.
voices.caption: The one who touched its leg said it was like a pillar.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: The ear, like a fan. <#0.2#> The trunk, like a snake.
voices.caption: The ear, like a fan. The trunk, like a snake.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: But no one <#0.2#> saw the whole elephant.
voices.caption: But no one saw the whole elephant.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: We all see the world <#0.3#> only from where we stand.
voices.caption: We all see the world only from where we stand.
